node.title: Intrinsic dyadic scales have a geometric quotient-row ledger
node.statement: If each intrinsic scale M=2^j class injects into a primitive quotient-row family of size at most C(n/M)^B, their disjoint aggregate is less than Cn^B/(2^B-1). At B=6 the descended cost is below Cn^6/63, and coefficient C<=63/64 pays current and descended primitive classes together inside n^6.
